How every price is built

Out-the-door price

  • Vehicle price as listed, less the $700 family discount on Enterprise cars (not yet confirmed with the store).
  • Dealer fees: Enterprise Wayne $350 documentary fee; other Enterprise stores $399 plus the transfer fee to Wayne; other dealers as posted, or an estimate where the dealer says to call.
  • Sales tax 6% on price plus dealer fees: every car is registered in Pennsylvania, so the Pennsylvania rate applies wherever it is bought (Montgomery County has no local add-on; Philadelphia adds 2%).
  • Pennsylvania title $72 paid in cash, $108 with a loan (the $36 lien recording is added). Registration $48 for a passenger car.

Financing at a 725 credit score

  • Tier: 725 is "prime" (661 to 780).
  • Rate: Experian's Q1 2026 average used-car APR for prime borrowers is 8.77%; the default here is 8.75%.
  • Credit unions often quote 1 to 2 points lower. Get a pre-approval and change the APR box to match.
  • Minimum down: prime borrowers are commonly approved with $0 down; tax and fees are then rolled into the loan.
  • Payment = standard fixed-rate amortization on (out-the-door price minus down payment).
